info.name: Talentree API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection for the Talentree API. Organizes all Customer, Business Owner, Admin, and SuperAdmin endpoints with automated token mapping, environment configurations, and business flows.

item.name: 1. Authentication & Authorization
item.description: Public and user registration/login endpoints. Contains automated Postman test scripts that extract JWT tokens and save them into environment variables based on the logged-in role.
